description: Edit ONE automatic store notification (order status, verification code/OTP, welcome, review request …) that LetsBot sends on WhatsApp to the store's real customers when that event happens: change its message text in one or more languages, which languages are sent, its image/video/file (an https link), and/or switch it on (customers start receiving it automatically) or off (they stop receiving it). The previous text and media are overwritten, not kept. On a QR-connected number customers get the new text from the next notification; on an official (Cloud API) number WhatsApp keeps sending the copy Meta approved until the merchant syncs the new text to Meta in the panel. This tool itself never submits anything to Meta. Read it first with get_notification_template, keep every {variable} the merchant still wants, and only change what the merchant asked for.

active.description: Optional: true switches it ON (customers get it automatically), false OFF.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to save these changes.

enabled_languages.description: Optional: the languages this notification is sent in, e.g. ["ar"] or ["ar","en"].

media_url.description: Optional: public https link of the new image/video/file (only for a media notification).

remove_media.description: Optional: true removes the current image/video/file.

texts.description: New message text per language code, e.g. {"ar": "…", "en": "…"}. Only the languages given change.

name: update_notification_template
